Coram : K.S. RADHAKRISHNAN*, A.K. SIKRI
Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 - s. 2(s) - A medical professional, whether a workman - Held: A medical professional, treating patients and diagnosing diseases C cannot be termed as 'workmen' within meaning of s.2(s). Words and Phrases - 'Occupation' and 'Profession' - Distinction The question for consideration in the present petition D was whether medical doctors discharging functions of medical officers i.e. treating patients in Employees' State Insurance Corporation's dispensaries/hospitals are "workmen" within the meaning of expression contained in Section
Decision Date : 21-11-2013 | Case No : SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) No. 35821/2013 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
